page.overview:
What is Cabarka Union?

The Cabarka Union was a group that used Verazeen stones during the High Republic Era. Around 231 BBY, the archaeologist Tapel was surprised to see former Jedi Ty Yorrick use Verazeen stones, as he thought no one outside the Cabarka Union used them.

The Cabarka Union was mentioned in the first issue of the comic miniseries Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures — The Monster of Temple Peak, which was written by Cavan Scott and published by IDW
